Element.attribute: This work product defines a plan for scheduling test script execution allowing stakeholders to understand when tests for specific aspects of the target solution are performed. This information helps control the test execution and enables flexibility in planning for different dependencies during test execution. Updates to the schedule are made as necessary in order to reflect changing priorities and needs.
To communicate and obtain stakeholder agreement on a schedule to conduct and complete the test execution.

Topics typically covered in this artifact include:

  • Start and end dates for test execution
  • Groupings of test scripts and test data
  • Cross-team dependencies and integration points
  • Owner responsibility for test script execution
  • Status of test script execution, i.e., passed, failed, pending
